settings.mode.label: Read and write
settings.mode.description: One LED for any disk activity, or separate LEDs for reading and writing.
settings.per_disk.label: One LED per disk
settings.per_disk.description: Show separate LEDs for every watched disk instead of one for all of them.
settings.read_color.label: LED color
settings.read_color.description: Color of the shared LED, or of the read LED. Default: the primary color.
settings.write_color.label: Write LED color
settings.write_color.description: Default: a lighter or darker variant of the LED color.
settings.disk_colors.label: Colors per disk
settings.disk_colors.description: Disk name, then a color or "read,write" colors, for example primary,#FF8800. Overrides the colors above for that disk.
settings.size.label: LED size
settings.size.description: Diameter of each LED in pixels.
settings.off_brightness.label: Idle brightness (%)
settings.off_brightness.description: How bright an LED stays while the disks are idle. 0 hides it until there is activity.
settings.glow.label: Glow
settings.glow.description: Soft edge on a lit LED.
settings.disks.label: Disks
settings.disks.description: Device names from /proc/diskstats, for example nvme0n1 or sda. Empty watches every physical disk.
settings.poll_ms.label: Poll interval (ms)
settings.poll_ms.description: How often disk activity is checked. Lower values catch shorter bursts.
tooltip.title: Disk activity
